description: The parser needed a particular token or keyword at this point, and the source has something else. Common causes are a missing keyword that closes a block (`endmodule`, `end`, `endcase`), an unbalanced parenthesis, or a typo in a keyword.
actions: Write the expected token at the position shown.
Look at the source at the position shown, and at the end of the line before it: a syntax error is often noticed one token after the actual mistake.
